import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "crops": ["turnips", "pumpkins"],
    "land_available": 500,          # acres
    "water_per_acre": {"turnips": 50, "pumpkins": 90},   # minutes
    "pesticide_per_acre": {"turnips": 80, "pumpkins": 50},  # dollars
    "water_available": 40000,       # minutes
    "pesticide_available": 34000,   # dollars
    "revenue_per_acre": {"turnips": 300, "pumpkins": 450},  # dollars
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # --- Sets ---
    model.I = pyo.Set(initialize=d["crops"])  # crop types

    # --- Variables ---
    # acres of each crop; nonnegative reals, upper-bounded by total land available
    model.x = pyo.Var(
        model.I,
        domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=(0, d["land_available"]),
    )

    # --- Objective: maximize total revenue ---
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["revenue_per_acre"][i] * m.x[i] for i in m.I)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # --- Constraints ---

    # Land: total acres used <= acres available
    def land_rule(m):
        return sum(m.x[i] for i in m.I) <= d["land_available"]

    model.land = pyo.Constraint(rule=land_rule)

    # Watering: minutes used <= minutes available
    def water_rule(m):
        return sum(d["water_per_acre"][i] * m.x[i] for i in m.I) <= d["water_available"]

    model.water = pyo.Constraint(rule=water_rule)

    # Pesticide: dollars spent <= dollars available
    def pesticide_rule(m):
        return sum(d["pesticide_per_acre"][i] * m.x[i] for i in m.I) <= d["pesticide_available"]

    model.pesticide = pyo.Constraint(rule=pesticide_rule)

    return model
